name: Restaurant Gordon Ramsay
address: 68-69 Royal Hospital Road, Chelsea, London, SW3 4HP
dinnerNote: Menu Prestige, 6 courses (three-course à la carte £190)

menus.name: Menu Prestige
menus.note: Lunch and dinner, Tuesday to Saturday; cheese £40 extra

menus.name: Inspiration Table menu
menus.note: A separate table and menu; the restaurant publishes a sample

menus.name: Three-course à la carte
menus.note: Tuesday to Friday; also as a vegetarian menu

dressCode: No formal dress code, but please avoid shorts, tracksuits, hoodies and hats. Smart trainers are fine.
children: Young guests are welcome if they order from the regular menu. There are no facilities for babies or very young children.
bookingOpens: Online up to four months ahead, for 1 to 6 guests. Groups of 9 or more can ask up to three months ahead. On Saturdays only the Prestige and Carte Blanche menus are served.
groups: Groups of 7 or 8 book by phone and choose the Prestige or Carte Blanche menu; 9 or more use the enquiry form on the booking page.
